Description: Project-owner-approved local policy. Source URLs identify Microsoft technical guidance adopted by this policy; they are not CIS Benchmark requirements. Applies only to the designated primary Defender in observed Normal mode.
ApprovalReference: D-041 (four rules and scopes), D-042 (scoring); no native validation implied

Criteria.Name: Antimalware engine enabled

Source.Title: WinSec local Defender baseline: Antimalware engine enabled; Microsoft technical basis

Verification.ReviewedBy: Project owner; explicit approval D-041 and scoring delegation D-042

Criteria.Interpretation: Service status is not proof of active antivirus enforcement.
Criteria.Recommendation: Review service state and security-product coexistence.

Criteria.Name: Antivirus enabled

Source.Title: WinSec local Defender baseline: Antivirus enabled; Microsoft technical basis

Verification.ReviewedBy: Project owner; explicit approval D-041 and scoring delegation D-042

Criteria.Interpretation: Passive or third-party antivirus may explain a disabled state.
Criteria.Recommendation: Confirm the intended primary antivirus solution before recommending changes.

Criteria.Name: Real-time protection

Source.Title: WinSec local Defender baseline: Real-time protection; Microsoft technical basis

Verification.ReviewedBy: Project owner; explicit approval D-041 and scoring delegation D-042

Criteria.Interpretation: Runtime status is preferable to preference alone.
Criteria.Recommendation: Review real-time protection if Defender is the designated primary antivirus.

Criteria.Name: Behavior monitoring

Source.Title: WinSec local Defender baseline: Behavior monitoring; Microsoft technical basis

Verification.ReviewedBy: Project owner; explicit approval D-041 and scoring delegation D-042

Criteria.Interpretation: A disabled state requires antivirus mode and workload context.
Criteria.Recommendation: Review behavior monitoring according to supported Microsoft Defender policy.
